method.mode: existing-evidence consolidation plus residual-only delta audit
method.additional_source_investigation_limit: Only previously unaudited Rosetta hook surfaces, previously unaudited semantic consumers, or a new concrete contradiction could be opened.

classification_definitions.AUDITED_CLOSED: Existing source/call-site evidence and current implementation/tests close the destructive semantic risk for this exact supported snapshot.
classification_definitions.RESIDUAL_UNAUDITED: A verification surface is not executed or is unavailable, but no concrete destructive dataflow contradicts the static architecture.
classification_definitions.NEW_CONTRADICTION: New concrete evidence shows a translation hook can alter a branch, lookup, state, persistence, identity, save, or gameplay result.

areas.area: Modern Hooks and Rosetta queue composition
areas.conclusion: The localization callback is in Late after Rosetta, MSU, and Legends; generated tables precede compatibility wrappers and the wrappers are outer to the Rosetta getters they constrain.

areas.area: item getName and Poacher ammo semantics
areas.conclusion: Only the two audited Poacher semantic methods receive raw ammo names; ordinary item display retains Rosetta translation and damage/effect branches remain source-equivalent.

areas.area: item name copied to dog identity
areas.conclusion: The installed unleash_wardog, wardog_item, and legend_accessory_dog consumers receive raw item names while normal item display stays translated; actor identity and save state are not localized at the copy point.

areas.area: background getNameOnly and Donkey branch
areas.conclusion: The exact Donkey semantic consumer is source-language scoped and ordinary background display remains localized; scope and Rosetta language restore on success and exception.

areas.area: world name uniqueness, lookup, and persisted derived identity
areas.conclusion: world_entity.getName is globally raw because installed consumers compare unique names, recover settlement flags, and construct persisted party names; those consumers therefore remain language-independent.

areas.area: world display labels, settlement and port DTOs, and templates
areas.conclusion: Map labels and returned settlement/port DTO display fields are translated after raw identity is captured; non-display fields, routes, objects, cost, and caller-owned template variables are unchanged.

areas.area: actor getName, getNameOnly, getTitle, and getKilledName
areas.conclusion: The actor getter family is globally raw for semantic consumers; actor-provenance display DTOs and final display getters restore reviewed Japanese without changing m.Name, m.Title, identity, or serialization.

areas.area: actor title generation and display registry separation
areas.conclusion: HedgeKnight title generation receives source values, the full actor-title registry is limited to proven actor-derived displays, and generic contexts use only explicit collision-audited opt-ins; length ordering and raw-identity negative fixtures are enforced.

areas.area: actor-derived named equipment
areas.conclusion: The 13 installed equipment methods that persist an actor-derived name run in the raw actor-name scope; final item display permits the reviewed title fragment only in the audited possessive shape.

areas.area: player.onDeath, corpse, resurrection, and casualty stub
areas.conclusion: Death processing receives raw actor names/titles, so corpse and casualty state remain source-language; corpse-stub and exact corpse tile display boundaries translate clones or returns only.

areas.area: Legends.addFallen and obituary DTO
areas.conclusion: Fallen Name and KilledBy persistence stay raw; world_obituary_screen translates only the cloned returned DTO with exact reviewed cause mappings and unknown values fail closed.

areas.area: mood history reasons
areas.conclusion: Raw mood history is not wrapped at its getter or storage point because installed events can compare English reasons; translation occurs only in the existing final tooltip boundary.

areas.area: faction relation history reasons
areas.conclusion: Relation history and coalescing remain raw; the exact world-relations DTO entry is cloned and translated only after element, id, type, icon, prefix, class, and item allowlists match.

areas.area: contract description state and return boundary
areas.conclusion: contract.getDescription translates its string return only; m.Description, state selection, flags, serialization, and all installed gameplay consumers remain unchanged.

areas.area: contract names, open-contract DTO, arena, and return-item display
areas.conclusion: Open-contract titles, arena entries, and return-item descriptions are translated in cloned return data; exact marker/cardinality/color guards fail closed and contract/item state remains raw.

areas.area: event template variables and contextual item/kinship values
areas.conclusion: The wrapper clones caller-owned variable pairs, translates display values, and applies only audited context-specific keys; raw Flags.Item, caller arrays, event state, and save values are not mutated.

areas.area: Legends PronounTable families
areas.conclusion: Only known family/value pairs are mapped on cloned template data; unknown family or value is raw and caller PronounTable/state/save remain unchanged.

areas.area: Rosetta skill and item getter display surfaces including Jimmy tooltip keys
areas.conclusion: The prior theoretical non-injective name-key risk has no concrete same-entity or same-section destructive collision in the current reviewed skill/background set; broad skill/item fragment hooks are absent and current collisions are separated by type or collection.

areas.area: Rosetta perk metadata in-place translation
areas.conclusion: Residual-only inspection found Rosetta mutates perk Name and Tooltip, but installed consumers use those fields for tooltip/DTO display while gameplay selection uses Script/Unlocks and other semantic consumers use Icon/Const data; no save, identity, or gameplay comparison consumes localized Name/Tooltip.

areas.area: Rosetta generic UI boundaries and item type labels
areas.conclusion: Combat results, loading/dialog/log/tooltip boundaries and MSU settings/item-type consumers are display-only in the installed snapshot; Const.Items.getItemTypeName is consumed to build a display string rather than a bitmask or branch.

areas.area: source-defect and exact screen-ID display wrappers
areas.conclusion: Exact event class, screen ID, source-shape, placeholder, and newline guards restrict corrections to temporary display input/return data; native consumers are called once and event choices, rewards, mood, state, and save are unchanged.

areas.area: cross-cutting save, persistence, and identity invariants
areas.conclusion: Current semantic wrappers either provide raw getter values to semantic consumers or translate cloned/final display data. The focused harnesses assert m.Name, m.Title, Flags, history, DTO sources, arrays, return identity where required, and exception restoration.

areas.area: optional absence and future-mod semantic boundary
areas.conclusion: Optional targets are guarded and absent targets are not required. Rosetta's UPD mutation surface is not executable because mod_upd is absent from the supported snapshot. Any added or updated MOD requires dependency and semantic-consumer rescan before support is claimed.

areas.area: fully isolated live game composition and rendering
areas.conclusion: The generated MOD has not been loaded in a fully isolated game/user-data environment. Live hook composition, Coherent UI rendering, clipping, and runtime-only exceptions remain NOT_RUN. This is not a static semantic-architecture blocker because no concrete destructive dataflow was found.

residual_delta_investigations.consumer_result: Installed consumers use Name/Tooltip for UI; gameplay paths use Script/Unlocks, Const data, or Icon.
residual_delta_investigations.reopen_trigger: A new installed consumer compares or persists localized perk Name/Tooltip.

residual_delta_investigations.reason_opened: Previously documented theoretical non-injective key risk.
residual_delta_investigations.consumer_result: Current reviewed data has no demonstrated same-entity/same-section destructive collision; active/effect and background distinctions remain separate and broad fragment hooks are absent.
residual_delta_investigations.reopen_trigger: A reviewed mapping creates two English semantic keys with one Japanese key in the same runtime collection.

historical_findings.resolution: The port DTO boundary and its clone/state tests were implemented; the justbeggar contract moved to the cloned buildTextFromTemplate path; later actor-title and generic-context collision audits replaced the stale global-getter assumptions.
Item/background semantic scopes and globally raw world/actor getter families now protect the identified branch, lookup, generation, death, persistence, and identity consumers.

freeze.declaration: SUPPORTED SNAPSHOT semantic architecture FROZEN; new concrete destructive evidence only reopens
freeze.scope: BBJP-CF88150E7B355ECD32D9 static semantic architecture and focused harness contract
reopen_only_if: Supported source fingerprint or dependency version changes.
A newly identified getter consumer feeds a localized value into a branch, lookup, state, save, persistence, or identity operation.
A current reviewed mapping creates a destructive collision within the same semantic runtime collection.
A localization hook is concretely shown to alter gameplay or persistence.

current_audit_affected_checks: git diff --check for the two changed files
qa_evidence.full_test_rerun: NOT_RUN because this audit changed documentation/reporting only and the directive required affected incremental checks only.

final_conclusion: PASS: 23 semantic hook/consumer areas are AUDITED_CLOSED, the only RESIDUAL_UNAUDITED area is fully isolated live runtime/rendering, no NEW_CONTRADICTION was found, and blocker_count is zero. The supported-snapshot semantic architecture is frozen under the stated evidence-based reopen policy.
